title: Block Social Apps on Weekend Mornings on iPhone
description: Block selected social apps on Saturday and Sunday mornings on iPhone. Set one weekend schedule and confirm that the apps are available afterward.
direct: Create a recurring rule for Saturday and Sunday only. Select the social apps you want to pause and set a clear start and end time.
figureAlt: A phone face down beside a weekend planner at breakfast
figureCaption: AI-generated illustration. The planner shows the two mornings chosen for a weekend rule.
cards.decision.heading: Pick a block that fits your weekend
cards.decision.body: If you want breakfast or the first hour of Saturday to stay free from scrolling, start with that window. Leave calls and any other essentials available.
sections.detail-1.heading: Keep rules easy to check
sections.detail-1.body: One scheduled rule is available on the free plan. If you want a distinct weekday routine as well, Pro supports multiple schedules. Check which rule is active before changing or removing one.
sections.detail-2.heading: Decide what should stay reachable
sections.detail-2.body: Leave any route for urgent contact out of your selection. If you use the social service through a browser, blocking its app does not cover that route. Open the actual app you want to test.
faqs.reader-1.heading: Can I make it run on Saturday only?
faqs.reader-1.body: Choose Saturday as the scheduled day and check that Sunday is unselected.
faqs.reader-2.heading: Can I test it before the weekend?
faqs.reader-2.body: Review the selected apps and schedule immediately. Check the rule itself during the first planned weekend slot.

related.related.label: Block Selected iPhone Apps Until 8 a.m.
steps.step-1.text: Open Dying Soon: Screen Time Limit, grant Screen Time access and select the social apps you want to pause.
steps.step-2.text: Create a recurring schedule and choose Saturday and Sunday. For example, set 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. on those days. Review the days and the time before saving.
steps.step-3.text: Test a selected app while the rule is active and after it ends. Check the weekday selection if you can still see the block on Monday.
